column8: Named bundle of options (see --list-presets): applied above the saved config file and below environment and command line. Empty = none.

night: dark, rain-soaked, neon. pale-reach: bright, high-key, pale haze, the opposite lighting. With a cycle this is the state the run begins in. (legacy aliases oscura, luminox, dark, bright, day also accepted.)

off: hold the mode. dawn: begin in night and let the sun rise into pale-reach, then stay. dusk: begin in pale-reach and let the sun set into night, then stay. day: hold, rise, hold, set, and repeat. The light is one continuous sun elevation, never a cut.
Seconds a sunrise or sunset takes. Never less than 120: the light changes slowly enough that nothing reads as a flash.
Seconds held in night before a sunrise (cycle dawn and day).
Seconds held in pale-reach before a sunset (cycle dusk and day).

neon: magenta, violet, ice blue and a little acid green. violet: cool purples and blues with pink accents. refinery: sodium orange with teal haze and flare tips (opt in: orange and teal only ever appear together here). mono: white and blue-white light only.
Overall brightness multiplier applied before tone mapping.
Multiplier on the aerial haze that separates the far towers. 0 is crisp, 2 is heavy.
How strongly wet streets and glass reflect the neon when it has rained. 0 turns the reflections off.
Multiplier on the height of every building, mega-structures included.
How many blocks are mega-structures (arcology slabs, terraced masses, spire clusters with sky bridges). 0 is an ordinary skyscraper city.
auto: seeded regimes of 3 to 8 minutes drawn from the weather set, each blended into the next along a quintic curve. Any other value holds that weather.
Comma separated weather types the automatic regimes may use.
Multiplier on precipitation and fog density.
Shortest automatic weather regime, seconds.
Longest automatic weather regime, seconds.
Lightning in storm weather. At most 3 flashes per second, each with a soft 100 to 300 ms rise. Turn off to have storms without any flash.
Peak luminance delta of a flash as a fraction of full scale. 0.05 by default, never more than 0.2.
Freighters and the occasional colossal capital ship crossing the sky.
How many mid-size freighters are in the sky at once (1 at 0.34, 3 at 1, all 4 above 1.34).
Chance that a colossal capital ship crosses in each 7-minute slot. 0 for none.
Density of the small craft on the boulevard lanes, the scale cue. 0 removes them.
paperback: 1970s-80s paperback cover art, airbrushed gouache with bold color blocks and fixed grain. clean: plain smooth shading.
Saturation of the hull color blocks.
Time scale of the whole scene: camera, weather, ships and the day cycle.
Multiplier on the camera height (about 100 to 320 metres).
Multiplier on the sideways drift of the camera along the boulevard.
Shifts the composition sideways with a lens shift (verticals stay vertical). Positive moves the scene right.
Shifts the composition vertically with a lens shift. Positive moves the horizon up the screen, showing more street; negative shows more sky.
Fixes the city, weather, ships and camera so a run can be repeated. 0 = a new city every launch.
Testing: begin this many scene seconds into the run (everything is a function of time, so this lands exactly there).
Testing only: hold a lightning flash at its peak amplitude to measure the luminance delta.
